svg.title: neofetch
svg.desc: A neofetch style system card. A glitching pixel art portrait of Divyansh beside his specs: SDE at BITCS, Next.js, NestJS, Postgres, TypeScript, RAG and agents, building NeoRunners, CGPA 9.34, Jaipur.
